_comment: Art config: one entry per portrait key (card id, person id, or enemy portrait). Run `sanguo-art` after editing. See ART-NEEDS.md. Raw images live in pics/source/, generated ones in pics/processed/ (see pics/README.md).
_maps: chapter map backgrounds, keyed by quest id; wide landscape, scaled to 800px high into godot/data/art/map/
_cgs: story illustrations (CG) for story squares, events and interludes, keyed by the cg key in the story data; 16:9, scaled to 720px high into godot/data/art/cg/
